plan.title: Asset PR to RFQ award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the exact evaluation duration is not configurable through this domain step.
Use the product's mapped QA vendors rather than inventing or inviting a real supplier.
Publish the RFQ after its supported prerequisites are configured.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first QA vendor submit the requested quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Have a different QA vendor submit the lower quote of 90.
Verify that the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before evaluating the ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Assert that the lower quote ranks first and that both vendor bids are ranked.
Award the full event to the lowest-ranked vendor, corresponding to the 90 quote.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required approval remark.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase order.
Verify that one PO contains the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Open the events list to verify the completed event is available in history.
Switch to the History tab as required by the scenario.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
Verify that the PR list rendered after PO creation.
